visualize_densepose_outputs: visualize DensePose chart predictor outputs with bounding boxes on a BGR image using IUV data
create_u_visualizer: create a DensePoseOutputsUVisualizer to visualize U coordinate outputs with a custom colormap and alpha
create_v_visualizer: create a DensePoseOutputsVVisualizer to visualize V coordinate outputs with a custom colormap and alpha
create_fine_segmentation_visualizer: create a DensePoseOutputsFineSegmentationVisualizer to visualize fine segmentation outputs with a custom colormap
review_visualize_method: review the DensePoseOutputsVisualizer visualize method to understand how IUV outputs are rendered on images
